[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

Report Generated: [[REPORT_DATE]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date (Experiment Created): [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date (Run / Analysis Completed): [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Preparation:
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The sample loop was filled manually with the chromatography sample according to the experimental plan.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Run:
    • The predefined ÄKTA Pure protocol was started using the automation workflow.
    • UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) signals were recorded during the run with a sample interval of 1 second.
3.2 Run Parameters

The following run-related parameters were recorded for this process:

Parameter Placeholder Description / Unit
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Unique identifier of the automated process
Equilibration duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Duration of column equilibration (e.g. min)
Equilibration flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during equilibration (e.g. mL/min)
Load/inject duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Duration of sample loading/injection (e.g. min)
Load/inject flow rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during sample loading/injection (e.g. mL/min)
Elute gradient duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Duration of the elution gradient (e.g. min)
Elute gradient start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer B percentage of gradient (e.g. %B)
Elute gradient end [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer B percentage of gradient (e.g. %B)
Wash duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of post-run wash step (e.g. min)
Wash flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during wash step (e.g. mL/min)
CIP duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Duration of main cleaning-in-place (CIP) step (e.g. min)
CIP step 2 hold duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time for second CIP phase (e.g. min)
CIP step 3 duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of third CIP phase (e.g. min)
CIP step 4 duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of fourth CIP phase (e.g. min)
CIP step 5 duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of fifth CIP phase (e.g. min)
